// 01 · ABOUT

Engineering with intent.

I'm a Full-Stack Software Engineer on the Finance Engineering team at Sony Music in London, where I build and own financial systems end-to-end, from a platform serving 100k+ artists and labels to the caching and data layers underneath it. My toolkit spans Python and FastAPI on the backend, React and TypeScript on the front end, and AWS (Lambda, ECS and SQS) to tie it all together.

Before Sony Music, I interned at eBay UK, where I pitched the winning idea and led my team to win the company's Global Hackathon, and built parcel-tracking and analytics tooling with Java and Spring. I hold an MSc in Computer Science (Distinction) from the University of Birmingham and a BSc in Management from the University of Nottingham.

Outside of the day job, I mentor early-career engineers through Bridging Barriers and run Greenidge Goods, a Caribbean food brand I built from the ground up as a nod to my roots in Barbados.
